say:1:1410338001:0.source_cn: 主人，就在这里联系祖娅吧！

say:6:1410338003:2.text: Hey! This little gizmo's working like a charm! Hugin's really outdone himself!
say:6:1410338003:2.source_cn: 嘿！这个小玩意儿真不错！呼金出师了！

say:10:1410338004:1.text: Zanie, we couldn't find the general. What about you?
say:10:1410338004:1.source_cn: 祖娅，我们没找到霍根将军。你那边呢？

say:14:1410338005:1.source_cn: 我也在村子里搜了一圈，没什么发现。

say:18:1410338006:1.text: Then he's really disappeared! Could he have already...
say:18:1410338006:1.source_cn: 霍根将军真的失踪了！他会不会已经……

say:22:1410338007:0.text: Shh! As long as we haven't found his remains, don't give up.
say:22:1410338007:0.source_cn: 嘘，只要没找到他的遗骸，就别放弃。

say:23:1410338008:1.text: We dwarves are quite particular about these things. We wouldn't toss a body into the sea, nor would we stuff it into a smelting furnace.
say:23:1410338008:1.source_cn: 我们矮人在这方面还算讲究，既不会抛尸入海，也不会把尸体...

say:27:1410338009:0.text: That somehow makes it sound even worse!

say:28:1410338010:0.text: Don't talk nonsense! General Hogan wouldn't fall that easily! Maybe he's searching for us too!
say:28:1410338010:0.source_cn: 别乱说，霍根将军才不会那么容易死掉！他会不会也在四处找我们？

say:29:1410338011:0.text: What if he found the underground lift in Brimstone Village?
say:29:1410338011:0.source_cn: 也许，他也发现了深岩村有通往地下的升降机。

say:30:1410338012:0.text: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!
say:30:1410338012:0.source_cn: 有可能。主人，我们再去地下找找吧！
say:30:1410338012:0.male: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!
say:30:1410338012:0.female: That's possible! Magister, let's search below again!

say:35:1410338013:0.text: Whoa, whoa! Going down is easy, but getting back up is the hard part. Are you ready for that risk? One wrong step, and it's a one-way trip!
say:35:1410338013:0.source_cn: 下去容易上来难，你们先想好。万一没有这次的好运气，就很...

choice_prompt:36:1410338013.text: Whoa, whoa! Going down is easy, but getting back up is the hard part. Are you ready for that risk? One wrong step, and it's a one-way trip!
choice_prompt:36:1410338013.source_cn: 下去容易上来难，你们先想好。万一没有这次的好运气，就很难再上来了！

say:38:1410338016:1.text: Alright then! Looks like you're stuck with me a little longer.
say:38:1410338016:1.source_cn: 好吧，我似乎还要再给你们当一阵子向导了。

say:42:1410338017:0.source_cn: 祖娅，你打算继续陪着我们吗？

say:47:1410338018:0.text: You lot have no idea how to navigate down there—I'd never forgive myself if I let you blunder your way into some death trap.
say:47:1410338018:0.source_cn: 你们在下边人生地不熟的，我也不放心就这么撇下你们啊。

say:48:1410338019:1.text: Besides, thanks to you, my research is progressing nicely! I always repay my debts. So until you find your general, I'm tagging along.
say:48:1410338019:1.source_cn: 多亏你们帮忙，我的研究才有了进展。知恩图报，在你们找到...

say:53:1410338021:0.source_cn: 那我们出发吧，去找霍根将军。

say:58:1410338022:0.text: Not so fast! We need a proper plan first.
say:58:1410338022:0.source_cn: 等等，这次我们得做好准备再去地下。

say:59:1410338023:1.text: When dwarves go mining, we always leave someone at the entrance. If things go sideways, there's at least one person topside to haul up the rescue rope.
say:59:1410338023:1.source_cn: 下矿井的时候，矮人们一定会在矿洞口留人值守，要是坑里出...

say:63:1410338024:0.text: So, you mean we need someone on the surface to coordinate in case of emergencies?
say:63:1410338024:0.source_cn: 你的意思是，为了应对意外状况，地面上得留个人手与地下里...

say:68:1410338025:0.text: Exactly! You're quite smart, little one!
say:68:1410338025:0.source_cn: 没错！孺子，呃，仓鼠可教也！

say:69:1410338026:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
say:69:1410338026:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
say:69:1410338026:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.

choice_prompt:73:1410338026.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
choice_prompt:73:1410338026.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，最好让你的两个小朋友留在地上，万一有个三长两短，他们能从外面帮上忙。
choice_prompt:73:1410338026.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.
choice_prompt:73:1410338026.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, your two tiny friends should stay above ground. If things go south, they can coordinate a rescue.

say:74:1410338027:0.text: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!
say:74:1410338027:0.male: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!
say:74:1410338027:0.female: What?! No! Chippy must protect the Magister!

say:75:1410338028:0.text: Chippy, don't be stubborn. He needs us up here more.
say:75:1410338028:0.source_cn: 满满，不要任性，主人更需要我们留在这里。
say:75:1410338028:0.male: Chippy, don't be stubborn. He needs us up here more.
say:75:1410338028:0.female: Chippy, don't be stubborn. She needs us up here more.

say:79:1410338032:0.text: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!
say:79:1410338032:0.source_cn: 我们也会继续寻找霍根将军，必要时我和满满会向远方求援！
say:79:1410338032:0.male: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!
say:79:1410338032:0.female: We'll also continue searching for the general. And if anything happens, we'll call for reinforcements!

say:80:1410338033:0.text: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!
say:80:1410338033:0.source_cn: 好吧……满满明白了……主人，我和漫漫会完成使命的！
say:80:1410338033:0.male: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!
say:80:1410338033:0.female: Alright... Chippy understands... We'll finish our mission!

say:81:1410338034:0.text: Magister, you have to come back safe!
say:81:1410338034:0.source_cn: 一定要注意安全！满满会想主人的！
say:81:1410338034:0.male: Magister, you have to come back safe!
say:81:1410338034:0.female: Magister, you have to come back safe!

say:87:1410338036:0.text: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!
say:87:1410338036:0.source_cn: 准备好了就来升降机这里找我！动作要快！
say:87:1410338036:0.male: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!
say:87:1410338036:0.female: Once you're ready, meet me at the lift!

narration:94:14010346:0.text: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.
narration:94:14010346:0.source_cn: 你和满满、漫漫分头行动，而暗处的矮人们也决定分头跟踪你们。
narration:94:14010346:0.male: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.
narration:94:14010346:0.female: You part ways with Chippy and Hammie, each taking a different path. The dwarves lurking nearby exchange glances and quietly set off after you.

choice:77:0:1.text: Can I trust you two with this?
choice:77:0:1.male: Can I trust you two with this?
choice:77:0:1.female: Can I trust you two with this?

choice:77:1:2.text: I know you won't let me down.
choice:77:1:2.male: I know you won't let me down.
choice:77:1:2.female: I know you won't let me down.

say:96:1410338015:0.text: A friend, huh... That's a special bond. Color me jealous.
say:96:1410338015:0.source_cn: 朋友啊……真羡慕你们的友谊。
